note: Raised from a live Discord support thread: 1.2.0 flashed and closed on Windows 10 with no log anywhere. Two defects found - a fatal main-process boot error is structurally unloggable (no handlers, and the logger append is async so it never flushes on a dying process), and the update-only bundle unzips into a folder that looks exactly like the app but carries no Electron runtime. Original report NOT confirmed; the applier was checked and is safe.

Shipped a500b335: uncaughtException/unhandledRejection handlers with a sync write plus error box, update root renamed to -update-only, all three release baselines restamped from the 1.2.0 full manifests. NOT yet exercised in a real boot - the handler needs a live Electron crash and the root rename only takes effect on the next build.
Needs a live boot-crash smoke test (throw, confirm dialog + FATAL line, revert) and a 1.3.0 build to confirm the update-only root name and that the archive name did not drift.
